title: SCE 1.3 Detective Probe: Validate CloudTrail and CloudWatch Detect EC2 Reconnaissance
description: Security Chaos Engineering experiment that validates detective controls (CloudTrail logging to CloudWatch Logs, CloudWatch Metric Filter, and CloudWatch Alarm) successfully detect unauthorized EC2 reconnaissance (T1580 - Cloud Infrastructure Discovery). A simulated attacker role executes ec2:DescribeInstances against the banking platform infrastructure. The experiment verifies that the API call is captured by CloudTrail, forwarded to CloudWatch Logs, matched by a metric filter for DescribeInstances events, and triggers a CloudWatch Alarm — confirming the detective control pipeline operates end-to-end as designed.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: CloudTrail and CloudWatch detective controls detect EC2 reconnaissance API calls
